name: Alaya Eco Villas
pinSource: Developer website project page (karmadevelopers.com/projects/alaya-eco-villas) embeds a Google Maps PLACE pin q=34.990059255170166,34.067716892960036. Cross-checked: ~650 m north of Konnos Bay (OSM 34.9842, 34.0670), matching the developer's Google Map screenshot (Konnos Beach 600 m, west of the Protaras-Cavo Greco avenue); cadastral layout is on the Paralimni sheet. High confidence.
amenities: Private overflow pool (1.40 m deep, built-in steps, 2 lights)
Gated entrance with video intercom and automatic gate
Automation system for lighting, A/C and blinds
Concealed ducted A/C on ground floor, VRV wall units in bedrooms
Solar lighting at parking and entrance
facts: Alaya is a scheme of five detached villas (H01-H05) next to Cape Greco National Park, overlooking Konnos Bay, between Protaras and Ayia Napa.
Villas have 4 or 5 bedrooms; plots range from 395 to 803 m² across the scheme (website availability list).
Villa H05: ground floor 60.60 m² (living, dining, kitchen), first floor 108 m² (four bedrooms), covered verandas 52.70 m² + 4.40 m², i.e. 168.6 m² internal and 225.7 m² total, on a 452 m² plot.
Structure: raft foundation, steel columns and beams with composite metal-deck concrete slabs; internal and external walls and ceilings of gypsum board filled with mineral wool.
A-class Energy Performance Certificate with a roof photovoltaic system.
Overflow pool 1.40 m deep with built-in steps and two lights; external free-standing shower.
Finishes: ceramic tiles throughout, Ceppo Romano porcelain countertops and vanity tops, Cashmere-colour carpentry, anthracite external walls and boundary walls, RAL 7006 aluminium frames.
No concrete boundary walls; communal management fee capped at EUR 1,200 per year (spec).

Developer-stated distances: Konnos Beach 600 m, nearest beach/swimming spot 500 m, Green Bay 1 km, Fig Tree Bay 2.5 km, Cyclops Cave 800 m, Protaras centre 3 km, Protaras Marina 6 km, supermarket 100-130 m, Larnaca Airport 42-45 km.
